characters.name: An Tas Duw
characters.title: God the Father
characters.description: The Alpha and Omega who sets the promise of mercy in motion.

characters.name: Adam
characters.title: The First Father
characters.description: The first man, whose exile begins the story and whose return to Paradise concludes it.

characters.name: Eva
characters.title: The Mother of All
characters.role: Source of Exile and Witness to Mercy
characters.description: The first woman, who shares in the toil of the earth and the eventual joy of the restoration.

characters.name: Seth
characters.title: The Son of Adam
characters.description: Adam's son who seeks the Oil of Mercy and receives the three seeds.

characters.name: Moyses
characters.title: The Prophet
characters.description: The leader who finds the three rods on Mount Tabor.

characters.name: Davyd
characters.title: The King
characters.description: The king who treasures the rods and marks their growth with silver rings.

characters.name: Salamon
characters.title: The Wise King
characters.description: The king who builds the Temple and attempts to use the holy wood as a beam.

characters.name: Maximilla
characters.title: The First Martyr
characters.description: The woman martyred for recognizing the wood's holiness.

characters.name: Jhesu
characters.title: The Second Adam
characters.description: The fulfillment of the promise who dies on the Rood.

characters.name: Lusefer
characters.title: Prince of Darkness
characters.description: The fallen angel who claims the souls of humanity.

characters.name: Gwreg an Gov
characters.title: The Smith's Wife
characters.description: The cruel woman who forges the nails for the Cross.

characters.name: Dismas
characters.title: The Penitent Thief
characters.description: The first human to enter Paradise after the Fall.
